title: Auto GG/GL/:3
description: Simple and very configurable mod that allows sending 'gg', 'gl', or ':3' by pressing a keybind
body:
stupid mod i made from scratch so you don't have to type gg or gl every single game, but i added the ability to also send :3 because i felt like it :3

you can configure the keybinds for it (defaults are `[`, `]` and `\` for gg, gl and :3 respectively), add more ggs, gls and :3s, and even change the suffix of the message! go crazy with it :3

## dependencies
this mod requires [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) v19.0.147 and [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/mod-menu) v15.0.0 to work
